description: 🛰️ Language-agnostic twin of the structured server-span vocabulary in `⏱️trace/📝️record/🦀️.rs`. `outcomes` is the closed set a span may end with, each with the level it is emitted at unless the caller overrides it; `events` is the declared server span/event name set an operator may alert on. A server is never refused an event outside `events` — the list is the contract of what is guaranteed to exist, not a whitelist — but anything an alert, a dashboard or a non-Rust consumer binds to must be here, so Rust and every twin read one file instead of keeping two hand-written copies.
